quest.subject: Computational Thinking & AI (CT & AI)
quest.title: Computational Thinking & AI — Class 9 May 2027 Quest

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Computational Thinking. which activity best represents decomposition?

options.A: Breaking a large problem into smaller manageable parts

questions.explanation: Decomposition divides a complex problem into smaller subproblems.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Computational Thinking. a step-by-step finite procedure to solve a problem is called an:
questions.explanation: An algorithm is an ordered set of steps for solving a problem.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Computational Thinking. a student notices that many school routes share the same sequence of turns. Identifying this similarity is:
questions.explanation: Pattern recognition identifies repeated similarities across problems or data.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Computational Thinking. in computational thinking, abstraction mainly means:

options.B: Focusing on relevant details and ignoring unnecessary ones

questions.explanation: Abstraction simplifies a problem by focusing on important features.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Algorithms and Flowcharts. which flowchart symbol usually represents a decision?
questions.explanation: A diamond represents a decision or condition with branching outcomes.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Algorithms and Flowcharts. in a flowchart, the oval symbol usually represents:
questions.explanation: The terminator oval marks the beginning or end of a flowchart.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Data and Information. which of these is an example of structured data?

options.B: A table of student roll numbers and marks

questions.explanation: Structured data is organised in a defined format such as rows and columns.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Data and Information. why should data be checked before training an AI model?

options.B: Errors and missing values can lead to unreliable results
options.C: To remove every unusual value automatically

questions.explanation: Poor-quality or biased data can produce inaccurate or unfair model outputs.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Introduction to AI. artificial Intelligence broadly refers to computer systems that:

options.B: Perform tasks that typically require human-like intelligence
options.C: Always have a physical robot body

questions.explanation: AI systems perform tasks such as recognising patterns, understanding language or making predictions.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing AI Domains. recognising objects in a photograph is primarily an example of:
questions.explanation: Computer vision enables systems to interpret visual information.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing AI Domains. a chatbot that interprets a typed question mainly uses:
questions.explanation: NLP helps computers process and respond to human language.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Machine Learning Basics. a model learns to predict house prices from labelled examples containing house features and known prices. This is:
questions.explanation: Supervised learning uses examples paired with known target labels or values.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Machine Learning Basics. a model groups customers by similar purchasing behaviour without pre-labelled groups. This is:
questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning discovers patterns or groups in unlabelled data.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing AI Ethics. an AI hiring system trained on biased historical data may:

options.C: Remove the need for human oversight

questions.explanation: Biased training data can lead a model to reproduce unfair patterns.

questions.subject: Computational Thinking & AI
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing AI Ethics and Safety. which practice is most responsible when using an AI tool for a school assignment?

options.B: Verify facts, acknowledge assistance where required and protect personal data

questions.explanation: Responsible use includes verification, transparency and privacy protection.
